GeoTrainer::Physical Geography::Concepts::Köppen::Climate Classes
Physical Geography — Concepts — Köppen — Climate Classes



Learn the Köppen–Geiger climate codes and the temperature and precipitation patterns they describe. These cards connect selected class/group codes with their names, criteria, examples and distribution maps. The maps represent the 1991–2020 classification.




How to study: Learn the group letters first, then retrieve the more specific codes. Read the answer explanations before grading; classification is based on climate patterns rather than a country label.




Read more: Classification and code guide · Af — tropical rainforest · Am — tropical monsoon · Aw/As — tropical savanna · BWh/BWk — desert · Cfa — humid subtropical · Cfb — oceanic
